mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, status, trigger_type, trigger_event, trigger_key, record_type, record_id, dedupe_key, trigger_outbox_id, execution_mode, actor_user_id, attribution_user_id, current_node_id, wait_kind, resume_at, lease_owner, lease_until, dispatch_count, cancel_requested_at, failure_node_id, failure_code, failure_message, started_at, finished_at, updated_at

wr.id, wr.workspace_id, wr.workflow_id, wr.workflow_version_id, wr.status, wr.trigger_type, wr.trigger_event, wr.trigger_key, wr.record_type, wr.record_id, wr.dedupe_key, wr.trigger_outbox_id, wr.execution_mode, wr.actor_user_id, wr.attribution_user_id, wr.current_node_id, wr.wait_kind, wr.resume_at, wr.lease_owner, wr.lease_until, wr.dispatch_count, wr.cancel_requested_at, wr.failure_node_id, wr.failure_code, wr.failure_message, wr.started_at, wr.finished_at, wr.updated_at, v.version_number, v.definition_hash AS version_definition_hash, v.published_at AS version_published_at

id, workspace_id, workflow_run_id, sequence_number, node_id, node_type, status, attempt_count, retry_safety, selected_outcome, selected_edge_id, next_node_id, failure_code, failure_message, started_at, finished_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_run (workspace_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, status, trigger_type, trigger_event, trigger_key, record_type, record_id, dedupe_key, trigger_outbox_id, execution_mode, actor_user_id, attribution_user_id, current_node_id, started_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{workflowId}, #{workflowVersionId}, #{status}, #{triggerType}, #{triggerEvent}, #{triggerKey}, #{recordType}, #{recordId}, #{dedupeKey}, #{triggerOutboxId}, #{executionMode}, #{actorUserId}, #{attributionUserId}, #{currentNodeId}, #{startedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM workflow_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_step_run (workspace_id, workflow_run_id, sequence_number, node_id, node_type, status, attempt_count, retry_safety, selected_outcome, selected_edge_id, next_node_id, failure_code, failure_message, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{workflowRunId}, #{sequenceNumber}, #{nodeId}, #{nodeType}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{retrySafety}, #{selectedOutcome}, #{selectedEdgeId}, #{nextNodeId}, #{failureCode}, #{failureMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})

INSERT INTO workflow_step_attempt (workspace_id, workflow_run_id, workflow_step_run_id, attempt_number, retry_safety, status, error_code, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{workflowRunId}, #{workflowStepRunId}, #{attemptNumber}, #{retrySafety}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_step_run SET status = 'running', attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, retry_safety = #{retrySafety}, selected_outcome = NULL, selected_edge_id = NULL, next_node_id = NULL, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND workflow_run_id = #{workflowRunId} AND node_id = #{nodeId} AND status IN ('running', 'failed') AND attempt_count < #{attemptCount}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status = 'running' AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

SELECT wr.* FROM workflow_run wr JOIN workflow w ON w.workspace_id = wr.workspace_id AND w.id = wr.workflow_id WHERE wr.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL AND wr.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND ( wr.status = 'queued' OR (wr.status = 'waiting' AND wr.resume_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (wr.status = 'running' AND wr.lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN wr.status = 'waiting' THEN wr.resume_at ELSE wr.started_at END, wr.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT FROM workflow_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status = 'running' AND cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY cancel_requested_at, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_run SET status = 'intervention_required', wait_kind = NULL, resume_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, failure_node_id = current_node_id, failure_code = 'dispatch_limit', failure_message = 'The workflow run exhausted its bounded worker dispatches.', finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status IN ('queued', 'waiting', 'running') AND dispatch_count >= #{maxDispatches} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND ( status IN ('queued', 'waiting') OR lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

UPDATE workflow_run SET status = 'running', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = DATE_ADD( CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), dispatch_count = dispatch_count + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND dispatch_count < #{maxDispatches} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workflow w WHERE w.workspace_id = workflow_run.workspace_id AND w.id = workflow_run.workflow_id AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL ) AND ( status = 'queued' OR (status = 'waiting' AND resume_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status = 'running' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) )

UPDATE workflow_run SET status = 'waiting', wait_kind = 'delay', resume_at = DATE_ADD( CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{durationSeconds} SECOND), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'running' AND current_node_id = #{expectedNodeId} AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE workflow_run SET status = 'waiting', wait_kind = 'retry', resume_at = DATE_ADD( CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'running' AND current_node_id = #{expectedNodeId} AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE workflow_run SET status = 'cancelled', wait_kind = NULL, resume_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, cancel_requested_at = COALESCE(cancel_requested_at, #{finishedAt}), finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status IN ('queued', 'waiting')

UPDATE workflow_run SET status = 'cancelled', wait_kind = NULL, resume_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, cancel_requested_at = COALESCE(cancel_requested_at, #{finishedAt}), finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'running' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL

UPDATE workflow_run SET status = 'cancelled', wait_kind = NULL, resume_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'running' AND cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE workflow_run SET status = 'waiting', wait_kind = 'retry', resume_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), failure_node_id = NULL, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, finished_at = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'intervention_required' AND current_node_id = #{expectedNodeId}
